description: WebDAV .NET is a WebDAV protocol client library for .NET, supporting all WebDAV methods and properties specified in RFC 4918. It lets you upload, download, copy, move, rename, lock and delete files and folders, create and browse collections, list folders and subfolders recursively, check whether a file or folder exists, and read and update properties on any WebDAV enabled server. The library is written in 100% managed code and does not require any other third party application or library to work.
